materials.content:
Charcoal on moderately thick, cream, slightly textured laid paper; Watermark: Blind stamp at corner, STRATHMORE with thistle
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance: Estate of the artist, 1986; The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, Abiquiu, New Mexico, 1991 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive. Completed in New York before June move to Virginia on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. O'Keeffe wrote: "*Blue Lines* was first done in charcoal." (*Some Memories of Drawings* [1988], unpaginated). See cat. nos. 63, 64. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977.
titles.title: First Drawing of Blues Lines
First Drawing of the Blue Lines

description: A smudged black line runs horizontally along the bottom third of the paper. Two thin vertical lines rise from the horizontal one. The leftmost vertical line zigzags downward, then continues its upward path, creating a sideways Z shape. These elements stand out from a plain white background.
imageCaption: Courtesy of National Gallery of Art.
title: First Drawing of the Blue Lines
